description: For game developers: test the link of a browser game against Hocus Games' submission requirements, without submitting. Reports problems that would stop a submission (not https, page not loading, robots.txt blocking HocusGamesBot, already listed or submitted) and advice (whether the game can play inside Hocus Games or only be linked, and how to allow it; a missing phone viewport tag). Run it before submit_game and help the developer fix what it flags.

game_url.description: The https page where the game plays.

name: check_game_url
title: Check a game before submitting it
